# Dead Archive: privacy policy and support

Static pages, published with GitHub Pages so the App Store has a privacy policy URL and a support URL that resolve. In English, Spanish and Portuguese:

- <https://ciderstudios.github.io/dead-archive-site/privacy.html> (`es/privacy.html`, `pt/privacy.html`)
- <https://ciderstudios.github.io/dead-archive-site/support.html> (`es/support.html`, `pt/support.html`)

**Do not edit these files here.** They come from `docs/site/` in the game's own (private) repository and are pushed by `tools/publish_site.sh`. An edit made here is overwritten by the next publish.

Bugs and questions about the game go in this repository's [issues](https://github.com/ciderstudios/dead-archive-site/issues): that is the contact route the support page points to.
